FDA Gives Marketing Clearance to American Bio-Medica’s New "Drug" Tests

American Bio Medica gets marketing okay

ANCRAMDALE, N.Y.,

American Bio Medica Corp. said Wednesday the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) gave marketing clearance to its eight panel Rapid Drug Screen test.

The drug test detects the presence or absence of THC (an agent found in marijuana)

FDA clearance of the eight panel version of the urine test opens the door for marketing to clinical sectors, such as emergency rooms, said the company, which also produces a five panel version of the drug test.

In the eight panel version, the product tests for benzodiazepines and includes both PCP and methamphetamine tests. PCP and methamphetamine are optional choices in the five panel kit.
